verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party docs describe describing an app in natural language and Lovable generating frontend, backend, database, auth, and integrations end-to-end (lovable-docs-1, -27, -31), with autonomous Build/Agent mode executing tasks (lovable-docs-4, -29) and getting a full app live in ~10 minutes (lovable-docs-28). Community evidence corroborates real-world use for MVPs with login/database (lovable-comm-12) and functioning hosted apps (lovable-comm-9), though some users report quality/differentiation limitations (lovable-comm-4, lovable-comm-13). Missing for 10: independent benchmark of full-stack completeness across varied use cases and no rigorous third-party audit of generated app robustness.
